Pick a product to inspect

Choose a category, then select any product to see its identity, classification, per-segment pricing, discounts and tax treatment — all joined from across the workbook.

Built from KENYA_2_0_PRODUCT_DATA_UPC. Every product is linked to its price rows (MKT_PC_PRODUCT_PRICE), discount/modifier rows (MKT_PC_PRODUCT_MODIFIER) and tax rows (MKT_PC_PRODUCT_TAX → TAX_CLASS_MST/DETAIL) by PRODUCT_ID; segments, charge types and categories are resolved to their names.
